page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c9h.8xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture utilizing a Hygon 7447v processor running at a clock speed of 2.6 GHz. The instance is configured with 32 dedicated physical cores and 32 vCPUs, operating with a single thread per core configuration. This dedicated CPU allocation ensures that compute resources are not shared with other tenants, providing consistent execution performance.

The instance is equipped with 64.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 2.0 GB per core. It does not include any local storage or integrated GPUs, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 10 Gbps.

Given its 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and dedicated physical cores, the ecs.c9h.8xlarge is designed for compute-intensive workloads that require predictable CPU performance without the overhead of hyperthreading. This hardware profile is qualitatively cost-efficient for parallel processing tasks, batch processing, and compute-heavy web serving where memory demands are secondary to raw processing power.
